info.title: Stylome API
info.description:
Analyze text with an explicit model ID. **`stylome-1.2-large`** returns `human_written`, `ai_edited`, or `ai_generated` in `label`, plus low/medium/high `confidence`. These are the only scoring-related outputs. AI edited means retained human authorship with an AI contribution, not an estimated AI percentage. Confidence describes relative KNN support; it is not a probability of correctness. The 1.2 response omits numerical diagnostics, internal identities, and alternate decisions. `response_version` identifies the public schema and opaque `evaluation_version` identifies the frozen evaluation configuration.

For 1.2, omit `operating_point` to use **`0.01%`**, or choose `0.1%`. These names refer to calibration false-positive-rate targets, not a guarantee on new data. The response includes only the selected operating-point decision. Whitespace is collapsed without Unicode compatibility normalization; submit 200–10,000 normalized Unicode characters. Oversized inputs are rejected, never silently truncated.

Fixed-point FPR, recall, accuracy, confusion matrices, and confidence-tier summaries can be reproduced from labels using the published dataset selection, exclusions, preprocessing, class mappings, evaluation version, and operating point. ROC/AUROC and arbitrary threshold sweeps require continuous scores and are unavailable through the 1.2 public contract.

**`stylome-1.0-large`** retains its model-specific 1.0 score/probability response and does not support operating-point selection or KNN confidence. Retired model IDs, including `stylome-large-1.0`, are rejected. Authentication, quotas, and data-retention policies are unchanged.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 1.2 relative KNN support for the returned class, based on neighbor agreement, proximity, and decision margin against calibration examples. Not a probability of correctness. Not provided for 1.0.

usage.description: Committed normalized-character usage and cost; null only for a replay from before prepaid billing.

ApiLegacyScore.title: ApiLegacyScore
ApiLegacyScore.description: Stylome 1.0 Large's existing score/probability response. No 1.2 confidence is computed.

usage.description: Committed normalized-character usage and cost; null only for a replay from before prepaid billing.

text.title: Text
text.description: Text to analyze. For stylome-1.2-large, whitespace is collapsed without Unicode compatibility normalization; the result must contain 200–10,000 Unicode characters. Inputs are never silently truncated.

model.title: Model
model.description: Required public model ID. Use stylome-1.2-large for ternary classification, or stylome-1.0-large for the 1.0 response contract.

operating_point.title: Operating Point
operating_point.description: stylome-1.2-large only. Omission selects 0.01%; 0.1% is also available. These are calibration false-positive-rate targets, not confidence levels or guarantees of the false-positive rate on new data. Omit this field for stylome-1.0-large.

description.title: Description
description.default: API and database reachability with inference configuration presence. Does not run inference or measure model availability.

description.title: Description
description.default: Request-ledger operations by start time; excludes idempotent replays and failures before ledger creation. Costs are exact prepaid debits; historical unpriced requests have no inferred charge.

input_characters.title: Input Characters
input_characters.description: Normalized Unicode code points; the same normalization used for inference and input limits.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Original operation's committed cost. An idempotent replay does not charge this amount again.

ApiKeyBearer.description: A Stylome developer API key or an approved OAuth access token in the Authorization header.
